description: This file provides a minimal polyfill for the fetch API to handle environments where fetch may not be available, such as server-side rendering (SSR) in Node. It defines a function that ensures fetch exists globally, throwing an error if fetch is missing.

methods.name: export async function ensureFetch(): Promise<void> { ensureFetch
methods.description: Ensures that the fetch function exists in the global environment; if not, defines a stub that throws an error.

ctags.name: g
ctags.pattern: /^  const g: any = (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : {}) as any;$/
